expectations.text: Applies the order of review starting with the USML, noting the VIII(a)(8) exclusion for survivability-enhanced aircraft effective October 13, 2026
expectations.evidence: "Step 2. Test the aircraft against the USML (22 CFR 121.1, Category VIII)" ... "is EXCLUDED from USML VIII(a)(8) as a 'survivability-enhanced aircraft'" ... "effective October 13, 2026."

expectations.text: Checks the secured ASE definition elements: DIRCM, associated IR/UV missile warning, anti-tamper measures
expectations.evidence: "'Secured ASE' means DIRCM plus the associated IR/UV missile-warning system, with anti-tamper."

expectations.text: Concludes the qualifying aircraft moves to EAR jurisdiction while the ASE stays in USML XI(a)(4)
expectations.evidence: "If all conditions are met, the aircraft is not a VIII(a)(8) article ... Resolve the EAR classification" and "The ASE remains USML XI(a)(4)."

expectations.text: Cites the new definitional provisions (22 CFR 121.0 and 120.54 additions)
expectations.evidence: "The rule adds definitions to 22 CFR 121.0 and new 22 CFR 120.54(a)(8)-(9) on secured ASE activities."

expectations.text: Recommends re-running jurisdiction and classification analyses for affected product lines after October 13, 2026
expectations.evidence: Advises documenting the classification and reviewing "whenever the configuration changes," but never recommends re-running jurisdiction/classification analyses across affected product lines now that the rule is effective.
